steps.title: Step I — intro: angles (previous knowledge)
steps.content:
Teacher displays the drawings of angles on the board asking from the students at random the
various angles while the students respond to teachers questions. Teacher adopts the students
answers if correct, otherwise teacher corrects the student and the lesson progresses.

activities.what: displays the drawings of angles on the board, asking the students at random the various angles
adopts the students' answers if correct, otherwise corrects the student

steps.title: Step II — types of plane shapes, their properties, similarities and differences
steps.content:
Teacher draws the various shapes on the board while students identify their properties. The
teacher writes the properties of the shapes on the board for the students to learn.

activities.what: draws the various shapes on the board
writes the properties of the shapes on the board for the students to learn

blocks.content:
**Hints**

Plane shapes are also known as two dimensional shapes (2-D shapes). They include: triangle,
rectangle, squares, parallelogram, trapezium, circle and other polygons.

**Polygons**

A polygon is a closed shape that has three or more straight sides.

| Name of Polygon | No of sides | No of triangle ($n-2$) |
|---|---|---|
| Triangle | 3 | 1 |
| Quadrilateral | 4 | 2 |
| Pentagon | 5 | 3 |
| Hexagon | 6 | 4 |
| Heptagon | 7 | 5 |
| Octagon | 8 | 6 |
| Nonagon | 9 | 7 |
| Decagon | 10 | 8 |
| Hendecagon or undecagon | 11 | 9 |
| Dodecagon | 12 | 10 |
